lines: Sea otters hold hands while they sleep.
It is not just cute. It keeps them safe.
Ocean currents could carry a sleeping otter away from its family.
So they link paws and float together in groups called rafts.
Some also wrap themselves in kelp, like a seaweed seatbelt.
And they keep a favorite rock in a pocket of loose skin, to crack open shellfish.
Who would you hold hands with? Tell us in the comments.
